meta.name: redesign-existing-projects
meta.description: Upgrades existing websites and apps to premium quality. Audits current design, identifies generic AI patterns, and applies high-end design standards without breaking functionality. Works with any CSS framework or vanilla CSS.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将现有网站和应用的视觉设计提升至高端品质
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果手头有设计粗糙的网站或应用，想在不破坏功能的前提下提升视觉品质
copy.tagline_en: Upgrade existing websites and apps to premium visual quality
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have a rough-looking site or app and want to elevate its design without breaking functionality

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会先扫描你现有项目的代码和样式方案,列出发现的设计问题(默认字体、纯黑背景、三栏等宽卡片、缺失的交互状态等),再在不重写的前提下针对现有技术栈逐项修改升级。
howto.when: 当你让它改造现有网站或应用的外观,或提到「重设计」「升级设计」等说法时触发;支持 Tailwind、原生 CSS 等样式方案。

say.text: 帮我审一遍这个项目的设计,列出所有通用 AI 风格的问题
say.note: 会先扫描代码,再给诊断清单

say.text: 把首页的纯黑背景和三栏等宽卡片改掉,别动功能
给按钮和卡片补上 hover、按下和加载状态

howto.what_en: After installing, Claude scans your existing project's code and styling setup, lists the generic AI patterns and weak points it finds, then applies targeted upgrades to the current stack without rewriting anything.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to improve or restyle an existing site or app, e.g. "redesign this page" or "audit the design". Works with Tailwind, vanilla CSS, and other frameworks.

say_en.text: Audit this project's design and list every generic AI pattern you find.
say_en.note: Scans the code first, then reports

say_en.text: Fix the pure black background and equal card columns; don't break features.
Add hover, pressed, and loading states to buttons and cards.
